scope: Pre-authority narration-first opening-shot study for EP008. This is an isolated experiment, not a V4 artifact, Step 4 gate pass, production-state work order, asset authorization, or production select.
objective: Author a precise shot-direction proposal for the locked 0.000-48.520 second EP008 cold open, derived from exact narration timing before footage selection. Use the original video only as a named treatment reference under an explicit non-imitation ruling.

inputs.standing: treatment reference only; no composition, fact, timing, scene assignment, or approval carries forward

acceptance_checks: Recompute every input hash before authoring and stop on drift
Cover exactly 0.000-48.520 seconds and W000000-W000159 without changing or paraphrasing narration
Define one dramatic question and one visual sentence for the opening
For every shot name exact in and out times, word IDs, verb, job, foreground midground background, persistent objects, transition, and excluded coverage
Use only Boundary Ledger semantic roles and operations; distinguish canonical color from provisional motion expression
Treat the engine and world as hypotheses only and flag any direction that depends on an open semantic blocker
State what is learned from the original video and what distinctive composition, copy, claims, scene assignments, and identity are not copied
Prefer human reality, one accountable action, and causal state change over topical illustration or sentence cards
Return no approval and do not create media, renderer code, canonical artifacts, or production state
stopping_conditions: Stop if any declared input hash is stale
Stop if the opening requires a fact, object, or state transition absent from the locked narration or candidate world
Stop before selecting footage, generating imagery, or claiming any gate pass
